label: Contract labour migration corridors
source: National labour-export agencies (Nepal MoLESS, SLBFE, India MEA, Pakistan BE&OE, Philippines DMW, Indonesia BP2MI, Viet Nam MOLISA, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Kenya); recruitment costs from KNOMAD-ILO Migration Costs Surveys, ILO, national cost surveys
method: Each line is a sending-to-receiving corridor; v is the number of workers deployed in the stated year as reported by the sending country's agency (null where no deployment count was found). Text adds the documented recruitment cost or debt finding where a survey gives one.

Pakistan Economic Survey 2024-25 (BE&OE data), 2024: 452,562 workers (62% of all registered). Cost: ILO 2016 survey found Saudi-bound workers needed around 9 months of earnings to break even; average outlay across Saudi Arabia and UAE $3,489, against official fees of $201-$463. Pakistan Economic Survey 2024-25 (BE&OE data), 2024: 64,130 workers (9%). Cost: ILO 2016 survey found UAE-bound workers needed around 6 months of earnings to break even; lowest district average $1,863 (Gujrat).

Ami Probashi annual report, as reported by Prothom Alo, 2024: about 627,000 workers (62.17% of 1,009,146). Cost: BBS Cost of Migration Survey (2020) found Saudi-bound workers paid 2.6 times the government-fixed amount; average cost Tk 4.17 lakh, 17.6 months to recoup (all destinations).

Ami Probashi annual report, as reported by Prothom Alo, 2024: about 93,000 workers. Cost: BBS (2020) found Malaysia-bound workers paid 2.5 times the government-fixed amount; UN experts (2025, cited by HRW) reported fees up to five times the official rate and 'deepening debt bondage'.

No annual deployment figure found in an opened source. Cost: BBS Cost of Migration Survey (2020) found Singapore the costliest destination, average Tk 5.74 lakh, 15.1 months to recover (government-fixed cost Tk 2.62 lakh).

ILO 2020 (KNOMAD method), survey July-Sept 2018: mean recruitment cost $394, about 1.4 months of earnings. As of 2019 about 65% of Thailand's 2,877,000 documented workers from Myanmar, Cambodia and Lao PDR were from Myanmar. No annual deployment figure in the source.

ILO 2020 (KNOMAD method), survey July-Sept 2018: mean recruitment cost $517, about 2.5 months of earnings (highest of the three). About 25% of the 2,877,000 documented workers (2019). Borrowers from moneylenders paid a median 20% interest per month (all three origins).
ILO 2020 (KNOMAD method), survey July-Sept 2018: mean recruitment cost $503, about 2.3 months of earnings. About 9% of the 2,877,000 documented workers (2019).

FY2023: 310,676 H-2A visas issued in total, about 92% to Mexicans (State Dept data summarized by UC Davis Rural Migration News; GAO-25-106389 gives almost 310,000). Recruiters in Mexico charge workers to learn about jobs; a 2021 federal indictment in Georgia (Operation Blooming Onion) charged 24 defendants with forcing H-2A workers from Mexico, Guatemala and Honduras to pay unlawful fees and freed more than 100 workers.

Ethiopia Ministry of Labour and Skills: about 345,000 citizens placed abroad in the fiscal year ending July 2024, to Saudi Arabia, UAE, Jordan and Qatar (no per-country split given). Cost: KNOMAD-ILO survey (2015) 4th-quintile cost $1,068.
National Employment Authority, 'Foreign Job Placements for Kenyan Workers' (2022/23-2023/24, two years combined), as reported by The Standard: 194,320 placements in Saudi Arabia, the top destination.

Russian Interior Ministry (via Kommersant interview, Sept 2024): over 1.88 million Uzbek citizens travelled to Russia in Jan-Aug 2024; about 1.792 million working there. KNOMAD-ILO 2016 surveyed this corridor (non-recruited workers). Entries, not deployments.
Russian Interior Ministry (via Kommersant interview, Sept 2024): over 1.2 million Tajik labour migrants in Russia (stock). KNOMAD-ILO 2016 surveyed this corridor (non-recruited workers).
